routes.reason: No atlas roadmap proves GSp₄ modularity lifting, constructs GSp₄-valued Galois representations over torsion Hecke algebras, or does local–global compatibility at p for Siegel forms, so a new roadmap is justified; area langlands is a galaxy id. The review added Theorem 1.2, Assumptions 6.12(2)/6.16, the non-simple-generic case of Proposition 6.8, the injectivity of the secondary Hasse invariant on S, and hypothesis (6) of Theorem 9.1 for a ≥ 4. An addendum to the reason records E158–E161 for the design job.

AlgebraicModularFormsAndSerreWeights stops at algebraic modular forms and Serre weights; Siegel forms of genus two modulo pⁿ, their q-expansions and theta operators are planned nowhere. The review added the irreducibility of Sym^n under SL₂(F_p).

AutomorphicBundles stops at characteristic-zero sections; the integral coherent complexes are new in its direction. The review added the 'contributes'/isotypic definition. CG18 routes to the same id, and make_queue.py does not merge same-id routes, so the maintainer merges the two design jobs.
SelmerIwasawaCohomology plans Selmer groups but not their vanishing from R = T; the appendix's argument is new in its direction. The review added the large-p finiteness step of Lemma A.5.

FaltingsFinitenessAndIsogenyTheorems plans Faltings's theorems but not Serre's open-image results for abelian surfaces. The review added Ribet's semistable-endomorphism bridge, which the use of Serre's corollary needs.
The additions are the GL_n parts of the appendix (Theorem A.2), which belong with CG18's conditional theory. It joins CG18's route of the same id; the maintainer merges the design jobs.
The single weight-one item belongs with CG18's defect-one GL₂ theory. It joins CG18's route of the same id; the maintainer merges the design jobs.

notes:
Accept after corrections made in place. The review was done by Claude Code (session cc-38267a) against the author copy of the published article (Siegel.pdf, SHA-256 fff30587…) and the arXiv TeX of the main text (1907.08691v1) and appendix (1907.08694v1), with eight checkers splitting pp. 800–896; they opened every cited declaration, read every cited layer description and checked every recorded mistake on the page image. The coordinator re-derived the substantive new findings in the TeX. Items: 66 corrected and 18 added (1 library, 4 planned, 13 missing), giving 415 (6 library, 82 planned, 327 missing). Mathlib at the pin already has SL₂(F_p) perfect and PSL₂(F_p) simple, which the extraction called missing; the item was split. Source issues: of E1–E156 (E124 withdrawn by the extraction), 146 are confirmed and 9 rejected: E39, E46, E47, E69, E106, E117 and E120 duplicate other entries; E75's headline claim is withdrawn by its own correction; E104's 'U² − TU + ⟨p⟩' is the standard Hecke-polynomial notation. E17 became an error. Several reasons were corrected in the verdicts (E4, E36, E57, E72, E73, E91, E115, E125, E139, E142, E145, E152). E157–E165 are new:
- E160 (gap, the proof): the Hasse-power surjections in the proofs of Theorems 6.13 and 6.17 must target the quotient by the annihilator of the β- (or (α,β)-) part, not of the whole space; trivially repaired.
- E158: Definition 6.15(2) needs η ≠ 0. E159: the Taylor–Wiles labelling α_xδ_x = β_xγ_x does not follow from isotropy. E161: Theorem 7.11's bound is p > a − 2.
- The rest are misprints.
Neatness (Assumption 4.2) follows from Assumption 4.1(H1). No main theorem changes. All 27 routes are accepted.
